## Overview

This 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured [[adyen]] Payouts landing page describes outbound transfers to accounts outside Adyen and separates two product routes. **Payouts combined with Payments** is offered to an Adyen merchant of record alongside payment processing for a beneficiary not onboarded with Adyen, such as a supplier. **Payouts as part of Adyen for Platforms** pays processed-payment funds to a platform merchant or sub-merchant. These routes have different actors and should not be conflated. This Payouts umbrella and its linked Payout Service child are separate from the legacy Online Payout API documented in [[adyen-payouts]]; the legacy Payout API integration, approval, and staged-review rules must not be inferred for Payout Service from this landing page. [[adyen-payouts]]

## Key takeaways

- The landing page links the merchant-of-record/third-party route to **Payout Service** and the platform-user route to **managed payouts**, which it describes as on-demand or scheduled. Its page title says global payouts in real time, but this hub gives no route-specific eligibility, funding, API, timing or completion criteria; follow the child guide for those conditions. See raw lines 15–30.
- This is navigation and product positioning, not evidence that a particular payout request was accepted, funds were debited, a beneficiary was paid, or a bank received funds. See raw lines 19–30.

concepts.proposed_markdown: The 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured [[source-adyen-docs-payouts]] landing page defines a broader Payouts umbrella: a Payments-combined Payout Service for an Adyen merchant of record paying a beneficiary not onboarded with Adyen, and a separate Adyen for Platforms route for payouts of processed payments to platform merchants or sub-merchants. This umbrella and its Payout Service child are distinct from the legacy Online Payout API material documented here; do not infer that API's integration, approval or staged-review rules for Payout Service from the landing page. The child routes own their distinct eligibility, APIs and payout lifecycle; the landing-page “real time” headline is not a completion guarantee.
